messages:
maya: Quick callout - saw duplicate apply logs during a staggered upgrade for tenant=acme cold prefix.

arun: probable cause = ownership flip while rehydrate in-flight. got a log snippet.

maya: ```[2026-03-23T02:11:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=acct-77 apply=ok node=shard-4
[2026-03-23T02:11:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=acct-77 apply=ok node=shard-9```

rick: yep, handoff raced with rehydrate. risk: non-idempotent downstream ops see double effects.

sasha: short-term mitigations: (A) op-idempotency at model layer; (B) demote fence until rehydrate done. both tradeoffs.

arun: also propose runtime marker for "recently-thawed" prefixes + metric rehydrate_origin and rehydrate_latency_ms. sequencer can gate suspicious rehydrates for T seconds.

maya: ops note - current drain timeout is 30s; increasing reduces races but slows rollouts. SRE input needed.

rick: i'll draft a concise RFC "rehydrate-handshake" w/ sim harness. arun will add metrics + small gate. canary ops flag to pause demote until ack_count>=N or rehydrate complete.

sasha: agreed. RFC by Fri EOD.
